scenarios.title: Welcome page provides a navigable reference link to database stored procedures
given: the user is viewing the welcome page
scenarios.when: the user inspects the navigation options on the welcome page
then: a navigable link pointing to the stored procedures reference page is clearly displayed to the user

scenarios.title: Navigating to the stored procedures reference from the welcome page
given: the user is on the welcome page
scenarios.when: the user selects the stored procedures reference link
then: the stored procedures reference page is displayed
the user can view the stored procedures documentation and details

scenarios.title: Stored procedures reference page displays server and database details
given: the application is configured with target database server and database information
scenarios.when: the user views the stored procedures reference page
then: the database server name is displayed on the page
the database name is displayed on the page
the stored procedures reference content is shown alongside the connection details

scenarios.title: Directly accessing the stored procedures reference page
scenarios.when: the user opens the stored procedures reference page directly
then: the stored procedures reference page loads successfully
the database server name and database name are presented to the user

scenarios.title: Accessing reference page when database configuration is unavailable
given: the database connection settings such as server or database name are unconfigured or unavailable
scenarios.when: the user visits the stored procedures reference page
then: a user-friendly notification stating that database connection details are unavailable is presented
the user can navigate back to the welcome page
